title: GG-BBQ: German Gender Bias Benchmark for Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on a multiple-choice question answering task using a translated German dataset (GG-BBQ) with ambiguous and disambiguated contexts. The evaluation calculates a differential bias score based on the model's reliance on social stereotypes when prompted with gendered group terms (e.g., man/woman) and proper names.
